text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit southbound and northbound U-turn movements at all times on Botham Road, between Stuart Avenue and a point 80 metres south.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited southbound and northbound U-turn movements at all times on Botham Road, between Stuart Avenue and a point 80 metres south.
